description: AI meeting agenda builder — Turn a meeting topic into a timed, outcome-driven agenda: objective, desired outcomes, pre-reads, items with minutes, owner, kind (decision/discussion/update/brainstorm/review) and the outcome each must produce, roles, opening question, parking lot and follow-ups. Minutes are rebalanced to exactly fit the meeting length, clock times added when start= is given, and offline checks flag decision meetings without a decision item, items over 40% of the time, too many items, missing outcomes, no break over 90 min and update-heavy meetings. Includes a Markdown agenda. Params: topic (required, up to 4000 chars), duration (minutes, default 60), type (standup, planning, review, decision, brainstorm, 1on1, kickoff, retro, status, workshop, interview, board, sales, general), attendees (comma list), goal, start (HH:MM). Example: /v1/ai/meeting-agenda?topic=Decide+Q1+pricing+for+the+Pro+plan&duration=45&type=decision&attendees=Ana,Ben,Cy&start=14:30 Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
